hero.title: Join our Program
hero.subtitle_prefix: Apply to join the Pan-Africa Bitcoin Academy and

form.heading: Application Form
form.intro: Choose how you want to learn, then complete your details. Live cohort students join a scheduled group; self-paced students use the same materials on their own schedule.

learning_pace.label: How do you want to take the course?
learning_pace.self_paced_box_desc: You will read the materials and progress on your own schedule. No live cohort or start date is required. Select your experience level below.

cohorts.heading: Upcoming cohorts
cohorts.subheading: Pick a cohort (or use the dropdown later in the form).
cohorts.empty: No upcoming cohorts at this time. Check back later or contact us.

note.text: We'll review and get back to you within 3-5 business days.

messages.success_verification_email: Application submitted successfully! Please check your email to verify your address. We will review your application and get back to you soon.
messages.success_default: Application submitted successfully! We will review and get back to you soon.
messages.error_existing_account: An account with this email already exists. Please sign in to access your account. If you forgot your password, use the "Forgot Password" option.
messages.error_already_approved: Your application was already approved! Please set up your password to complete registration.
messages.error_default: Failed to submit application. Please try again.
messages.validation_cohort_required: Please select a cohort for live cohort enrollment.
messages.validation_cohort_full: This cohort is full. Please select a different cohort.

community_connect.whatsapp_subtext: Get updates, ask questions, and connect with other learners.
